newsitem.title: GERMANY: FIGURE SKATING-GERMANS RALLY FOR PAIRS WIN.
newsitem.headline: FIGURE SKATING-GERMANS RALLY FOR PAIRS WIN.

text.p: Germany's Mandy Woetzel and Ingo Steuer staged a dramatic come-from-behind victory in the pairs event in the $230,000 Nations Cup Champions Series figure skating on Friday.

After finishing a disappointing fourth in Thursday's short programme, the Germans rallied in front of a home crowd of 1,500 spectators at the Emscher-Lippe-Halle arena in Gelsenkirchen with the highest-rated free skating exhibition of the day.
"I thought that I had forgotten everything about ice skating," said Woetzel, who made numerous errors on Thursday.
Woetzel and Steuer finished with 3.0 points. That was ahead of world champions Marina Eltsova and Andrei Bushkov of Russia and Kyoko Ina and Jason Dungjen of the United States, who tied with 3.5.

European champion Irina Slutskaya of Russia dominated the woman's short programme. The 17-year-old from Moscow took the lead with 0.5 points ahead of Tara Lipinski of the United States and fellow-Russian Olga Markova.
